in_marathi.name: सौरभ
in_marathi.long_meaning: सौरभ हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘saurabh’, meaning ‘fragrance’, ‘aroma’, or ‘pleasing to the senses’. In Hindu mythology, the god Indra is known as Saurabha, meaning ‘having a pleasant smell’.

in_bengali.long_meaning: सौरभ একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘saurabh’, meaning ‘fragrance’, ‘aroma’, or ‘pleasing to the senses’. In Hindu mythology, the god Indra is known as Saurabha, meaning ‘having a pleasant smell’.
